title: Rail-Optimized AI Datacenter Topology Input (fragment)
description: Defines a rail-optimized AI datacenter: an N-stripe RoCEv2 backend fabric plus an optional EVPN-VXLAN frontend/storage fabric, each in its own EDA namespace. Fragment variant: top-level required keys removed so individual fragments under inputs/*.d/ validate cleanly. The merged result is still validated against the strict schema.

dynamicLoadBalancing.description: Balance on measured link quality instead of a static hash. RoCEv2 elephant flows collide badly on static ECMP. Use true/false for the defaults, or a mapping to retune.

enabled.description: Set false to turn dynamic load balancing off while keeping the tunables documented.

mode.description: Dynamic reassigns flows from observed load; PerPacket sprays individual packets.

flowset_size.description: Flowset entries reserved per aggregate ECMP group.

sampling_interval_us.description: Interface state sampling interval in microseconds.

credentials.description: Device credentials used for node onboarding and by generated artefacts (clab, Ansible, gnmic).

node_profile.description: EDA NodeProfile name for node onboarding.

extras.description: Unconstrained topology additions that supplement a locked design. Resources here are labeled nvd-design:extras.

configlets.description: Additional or override configlets (raw SR Linux config patches).

bandwidth.description: Port speed as a bandwidth string.

platform.description: Nokia SR Linux platform model, e.g. '7220 IXR-H4'. Must allow the role it is used for.

switchGroup.description: A group of identical switches in one tier of a fabric.

count.description: Number of switches in this tier.

port_bandwidth.description: Speed of the ports used for fabric uplinks. Drives the oversubscription calculation.

mgmt_base_ipv4.description: Management address of the first switch; the rest follow in order.

mgmt_stripe_stride.description: Management addresses advance by this much per stripe, keeping each stripe in its own readable block.

name_template.description: Name pattern. '{i}' is the index within the tier (or the rail, for backend leaves); '{stripe}' is the stripe number.

uplinks_per_leaf.description: Uplinks each leaf takes to the spine tier. Must be a multiple of the spine count so every spine carries the same number of leaf ports.

platform_per_stripe.description: Per-stripe platform override, keyed by stripe number. Lets a later stripe be built on a newer platform generation.

gpuServerGroup.description: The GPU servers, rendered into the containerlab twin. Servers are never deployed to EDA — the fabric only knows the ports they attach to. There is no count here: it follows from stripes x servers_per_stripe.

name_template.description: Name pattern; '{i}' is the 1-based server number across all stripes.

mgmt_base_ipv4.description: Management address of the first server; the rest follow in order.

image.description: Container image for the server node.

storageServerGroup.description: Dedicated storage nodes, attached only to the frontend fabric.

name_template.description: Name pattern; '{i}' is the 1-based node number.

mgmt_base_ipv4.description: Management address of the first node; the rest follow in order.

bond_base_ipv4.description: Frontend bond address of the first node, as address/prefixlen. Subsequent nodes advance by one host.

image.description: Container image for the storage node.

endpoint_selector.description: Label selectors to match target nodes.

endpoints.description: Explicit list of target node names.

path.description: JSON path in the SR Linux YANG model.

config.description: JSON config payload as a string.

fabric_name.description: Fabric name used as a prefix for generated resources.

environment.description: Deployment target. 'containerlab' also generates the lab twin.

mgmt_subnet.description: Management subnet in CIDR notation, e.g. '172.21.21.0/24'.

backend.description: The rail-optimized RoCEv2 backend fabric, deployed as an aifabrics Backend CR.

namespace.description: EDA namespace holding the backend fabric. Must differ from the frontend namespace.

stripes.description: Number of stripes. Each stripe is an independent set of rail leaves joined to the others by the stripe-connector spine layer.

rail_size.description: Rail leaves per stripe, which equals the number of GPU NICs per server: every server puts one NIC on each rail.

servers_per_stripe.description: GPU servers attached to each stripe.

gpu_vlan.description: VLAN carried on the GPU-facing interfaces.

gpu_tenant.description: GPU isolation group membership label value.

stripe_id_step.description: Stripe N gets stripe ID N * this value. The stripe ID appears in the rail IPv6 addressing.

gpu_nic_bandwidth.description: Bandwidth of one GPU NIC, used to size the leaf uplinks.

oversubscription_ratio.description: Ratio of attached GPU bandwidth to leaf uplink bandwidth. 1.0 means non-blocking.

uplinks_per_leaf.description: Explicit uplink count per rail leaf, overriding the oversubscription calculation.

system0_prefix.description: Prefix the system0 loopbacks are allocated from.

asn_start.description: First value in the backend's ASN pool.

asn_size.description: Size of the backend's ASN pool.

ip_mtu.description: IP MTU applied by the Backend CR.

rocev2_qos.description: DCQCN congestion control (ECN marking plus PFC) applied by the Backend CR.

frontend.description: The EVPN-VXLAN frontend/storage fabric. Omit to deploy the backend on its own.

namespace.description: EDA namespace holding the frontend fabric. Must differ from the backend namespace.

name_prefix.description: Prefix for frontend node and LAG names.

system0_prefix.description: Prefix the frontend system0 loopbacks are allocated from.

gpu_vlan.description: VLAN the GPU hosts trunk into the storage bridge domain. Storage nodes are untagged on the same domain.

gpu_bond_base_ipv4.description: Frontend bond address of the first GPU server, as address/prefixlen.

isl_ip_mtu.description: IP MTU on the frontend inter-switch links.
